alex: Heads up — perf regression in staging for llama3-70b after the kernel-selector tweak landed. Token p99 latency ~2x on mid-sized prompts. Rolling buffers show a bunch of KV activity. :eyes:

julie: Which pool / route? hosted or dedicated staging?

alex: dedicated staging pool (ded-stg-3), workload is chat-template median len ~600 tokens, batch size 6.

priya: Can you paste the short flame/top callers?

alex: Quick profiler dump (filtered):
```
matmul_kernel_v2            54.8%  <-- increased since selector change
kv_cache_copy_shard         21.3%
rope_scale_shift             8.1%
attention_fallback_path     10.2%
other                        5.6%
```

sam: Hmm. Selector v2 prefers the new fused attention kernel when head_dim % 64 == 0 and sequence < 1024. 70b model has head_dim 128, so it switched. Could be suboptimal for large KV usage.

alex: Agreed. The old path kept per-head matmul layout which let us stream KV more cheaply. Fused kernel recomputes some KV metadata and triggers extra GPU->CPU memcopies in our current KV sharding code.

julie: Any quick experiment ideas? Force kernel override back to v1 for 70b? Or change batching heuristics to prefer smaller micro-batches so fused kernel stays off?

priya: Also double-check rope_theta handling — we had a separate change where rope defaults were adjusted for chat template. If rope scaling interacts with the fused kernel's precompute, that could amplify work.

alex: Reproduced locally with a minimal harness: forced fused=true vs fused=false. Results (median latency tokens/sec): fused=true -> 38 t/s, fused=false -> 72 t/s. Memory profile shows extra transient allocations in fused path around KV copy.

sam: Sounds like KV thrash. Two immediate remediations: (1) add a kernel_selector override for model_family=="llama3-70b" in staging config to prefer legacy kernels, (2) add an adaptive heuristic: if avg_kv_copy_bytes_per_request > X then prefer legacy path.

perf-bot: deploybot — kernel-selector rollback to v1 applied in ded-stg-3 at 2026-03-18T15:34:05Z :white_check_mark:

alex: I pushed an A/B job: kernel_override=fused=false for 24h and a run with rope_theta=8192 vs 1000 to see rope interaction. Will post numbers.

julie: Thanks. If that fixes it we should add a regression test in perf-qa that triggers high-KV chat templates and asserts no >1.3x latency bump after selector changes.

priya: Also let's log per-request kv_copy_bytes in the tracing hook so the heuristic can be driven by real traffic.

alex: Will do. For now rolling change to legacy kernels in staging + trace add.

sam: :thumbsup: follow-up issue for a longer-term fix: update fused kernel to honor streaming KV layout (avoid extra memcpy) or make selector aware of kv_copy_cost.

alex: Filing issue now and link to this thread. Thanks all. :rocket:
